name: Systems Biology
description: Introduction to the genetic code, control of gene expression, operons and regulons; signal transduction, signaling pathways and cascade, information processing and transmission, pathway dynamics; elements of process control, feedback, feed forward and cascade control, dynamics of closed loops, analogies with control of gene expression; basic graph theory, graph representation of metabolic pathways; examples of transcription networks, determination of simple motifs in genetic networks; guidelines for analyzing gene regulatory networks, circuit dynamics; modeling, simulation and prediction of cellular events, micro-macro relations; experimental methods, existing databases; platforms and applications; case studies from literature - circadian clock, metabolic networks, disease networks; new frontiers.
